Components / Surfaces

Chat thread

.dr-thread · .dr-bubble · --in · --out · __time · components/chat.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Today

  • Andriy M.:Your parcel is picked up from Podil, 21. On the way to Osokorky, 14.9:32
  • You:The courtyard gate is locked — the code is 4471.9:34
  • Andriy M.:Got it. I'll land at the entrance and send the delivery photo.9:35
  1. 1.dr-threadOne declaration, margin-top: auto. The thread fills upward, so the newest message sits against the composer and a short conversation leaves its empty space above.
  2. 2.dr-noteThe date, above the run of messages, not a divider through it.
  3. 3.dr-bubble--inThe other person's message on --bg-surface, anchored to the leading edge. --ink at 14.37:1. Radius 16, padding 10 / 12, capped at 260px.
  4. 4.dr-bubble--outYour message on --bg-muted, anchored to the trailing edge. --ink at 11.54:1.
  5. 5.dr-srThe speaker's name, heard only by a screen reader. Nothing announces which edge a bubble hugs (WCAG 1.3.1).
  6. 6.dr-bubble__timeA real <time datetime> on its own line inside the bubble. 12.5/400 --text-muted: 5.95:1 on the incoming ground and 4.77:1 on the outgoing one.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Message thread.

States

No state of its own: the bubbles are read, not used, and nothing in them takes focus. The composer is an action bar: its field takes the field states and Send the button states.

When to use

The chat thread is the one place in the product where two people write to each other. It stands on chat, the client's thread with the operator, opened from Chat with the operator in the tracking screen's contact sheet, and on chat-client and the per-service chat files. It is not a variant of the message block. That one is a centred state notice with a mark, a title and actions, and it shares only the word message with this one.

No bubble is green. A messaging UI normally spends its accent on the outgoing side. Here green is never spent inside card UI, and a thread repeats, so the ~5% budget would be gone by the fourth message. Messages are a sequence, so they sit at --snug: 8 apart, not the list's 28.

The messages are what the client and the operator write. The system's own words are the field's placeholder, Message, and the Send button's accessible name, Send message. The hidden speaker names are You: and the other person's name: the operator's, Andriy M.:, on chat, chat-aerial and chat-inspection, and the client's, Olena H.:, on chat-client, where the operator is the outgoing side. In system copy he is always the operator, never the pilot.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Message bubble and thread · inventory.md § 1 Message thread · microcopy.md § call (A12) · ui/kit.html § Chat thread

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Today

  • You:The courtyard gate is locked — the code is 4471.9:34
  • Andriy M.:Got it. I'll land at the entrance and send the delivery photo.9:35

A conversation between the client and the operator about one order, as chat builds it, with each speaker named for assistive tech and each message timed.

Don’t

  • DRON:Your delivery photo is ready.10:12

A system event dressed as a message. A bubble is a person speaking. To tell the user that something happened, use the alerts log for the record and a toast for the moment. For a state that fills a screen, use the message block.
